Needs changes before merge.

The new refusal covers both versions of the reported plate. The existing chamfer tests still pass. The verifier is unchanged.

Results, run locally:

- Trial merge with upstream main `0510ff382015bfb46f088c44436919c0b000de58`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base 0510ff382015bfb46f088c44436919c0b000de58`: four steps passed. Motion lib: 479 passed, 10 ignored. The selected app test build passed.
- `chamfer_modelled_edge`: seven passed.
- `chamfer_partly_bevelled`: two passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 32 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Safety mutations, run independently:

I temporarily restored `chamfer_ride.rs` from main `17b1b2b81`. I ran each new app test separately.

- `a_no_pick_chamfer_on_a_plate_bevelled_on_one_side_refuses_by_name`: red with the old file.
- `the_refusal_does_not_depend_on_an_extra_vertex_on_the_bevel`: red with the old file.

Both failed at the intended assertion:

```text
a partly bevelled edge loop with no picks is refused: ()
```

I restored the reviewed file. Both tests then passed. The worktree has no remaining source changes.

Extra suites run:

None required by the extra fixture and importer rules. This diff changes no fixture directory or importer. It changes no UI. No goldens moved.

Heavy lanes:

Not run by the author or this review. The final trial-merge dry run selects 223 steps in the motion and app heavy lanes. A dry run is not a pass.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer_ride.rs:73`: Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final PR head. Record the lanes and results in the PR body. Fix each unexpected failure before readiness. Upstream main's AGENTS.md, “Heavy lanes at review”, requires these results. The PR body confirms that they are missing. The local quick gate and mutations do not replace this check.

The PR remains a draft. The review label is `needs-rework`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
